positive_snippets:
I had such a relaxing and enjoyable stay at this hotel! From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel welcome and taken care of. The room was super clean, cozy, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. I especially loved the peaceful atmosphere and how quiet it was at night perfect for a good night’s sleep.

The location was also really convenient, with easy access to nearby attractions and restaurants. The hotel team was always smiling and ready to help, which made the whole experience even better.

Honestly, it felt like a home away from home. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and friendly stay. Can’t wait to come back again

Don't get fooled by photos and the Google location !! Yes it's in GK. But total waste of money.
"ROOMS ARE IN BASEMENT WITH POOR VENTILATION. BE AWARE OF IT !!"
Family suite is OK. Deluxe room had terrible smell coming in washrooms.
Despite asking the staff repeated times, no action was taken.
Coming to service..it's worst. No proper receptionist who can communicate professionally. There are 2 service boys who don't take any request seriously. Despite our request to get us the breakfast early so that we can leave airport on time, when we woke at 8am, they were still sleeping.
Breakfast service is terrible !!
